name: t23-g3
description: T23 / G3 increment 1. One bounded 256x128x256 m world holds two independent collapsible structures. Four clients connect and each is given an authoritative player capsule; alternating slots spawn in the west and east regions, so the connected players start geographically separated. Client 0 severs the west column (~tick 40) and client 1 severs the east column (~tick 100) — a multi-region collapse detaching one beam per region. Clients then excavate each region's floor ends (outside the beam spans, so each beam keeps a floor to rest on). Client 3 is a --late-join replica that connects after those heavy edits, pulls a dependency-complete baseline over a real QUIC bulk transfer, drains the catch-up queue, and lands one cut of its own. The server and all four clients must converge to one canonical topology hash, the committed topology-event stream must replay from baseline to that same hash, and every detached body must be reported at rest. Open G3 items (persistence crash-matrix, save/restart + traversal, resident-cache eviction, G4 8-client bandwidth + soak, 4096 sleeping bodies) are tracked in docs/reports/G3.md.
